text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD alert triggered - HIGH - gpu.alloc.throttle - 3 nodes reporting repeated allocation failures

pagerduty: Incident 98321 created and escalated to on-call schedule 'eng-oncall'

oncall-alex: Got the page. Looking now. Which pool?

maria-eng: Seeing it for gpu-pool-eu-west-2, nodes g4dn-3 and g4dn-5. Logs show repeated cudaMalloc failures followed by process OOMs.

samir-sre: Can someone paste the exact error snippet? I want the allocation size pattern.

maria-eng: Paste from g4dn-3 logs: ```2026-03-14T10:12:43Z model-server[pid:4215]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 2147483648 bytes)
2026-03-14T10:12:44Z model-server[pid:4215]: Attempted fallback quantized path but allocation still failed```

oncall-alex: Thanks. Initial hypothesis: sudden batchsize increase or bad kernel leading to unbounded cache growth. Any recent deploys to that pool?

infra-runner: There was a canary earlier on model-wip/7.2 rolled at 10:08 into the eu-west pool. Canary flagged higher kv-cache usage in telemetry.

oncall-alex: Rolling back the canary now. Maria can you start draining new incoming requests from g4dn-3 and g4dn-5? Use the drain-node script: `./ops/drain-node --node g4dn-3 --grace 30s`

maria-eng: Running drain on g4dn-3 and g4dn-5. Also enabling prefix-KV cache eviction on affected model: `rdwctl cache evict --model model-wip/7.2 --scope node`

samir-sre: I see repeated allocation spikes at ~2GB per request during a specific request pattern: long context + streaming. Might be a regression in the attention kernel.

oncall-alex: Good call. For immediate mitigation: 1) drain nodes 2) rollback model-wip/7.2 canary -> infra-runner 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size on pool to 1 and set per-request token limit to 2048.

infra-runner: Rollback issued: `deploy rollback model-wip/7.2 --to stable-7.1` - starters finishing.

maria-eng: Drain complete on g4dn-3, g4dn-5. Eviction ran. Nodes recovering, but one pod restarted with 137 exit code (OOM).

oncall-alex: Noted. Samir, will you start a quick memory profiler trace on the restarted pod to confirm source? Use `rdwctl trace mem --pod <pod-id> --duration 30s`

samir-sre: Kicked off trace. Initial heap map shows KV cache growth correlated with repeated tool calls (function-call pattern from customer A).

oncall-alex: Potential customer impact: partial degradation for heavy-context streaming on eu-west. Maria, can you check support filters for high-latency and surface to SRE/CS?

maria-eng: On it. I see ~12 open requests stalled in that pool; ticketed customers: cust-142, cust-887. Opening an incident banner and updating status page.

oncall-alex: PagerDuty, please annotate incident with affected customers and mitigation steps.

pagerduty: Annotation added to Incident 98321: "Rollback model-wip/7.2 to stable-7.1; drained nodes g4dn-3,g4dn-5; reduced batch size; investigating KV cache growth."

samir-sre: Trace confirms allocation peaks originate in new attention kernel when streaming + function-calls combined. We should pin model to quantized-variant and run kernel tests in CI.

oncall-alex: Agreed. Action items: (a) infra to finish rollback and monitor mem usage (infra-runner) (b) eng-ml to reproduce locally and open a PR to revert attention kernel change (samir-sre, maria-eng) (c) CS to contact cust-142 and cust-887 with ETA and mitigation (oncall-alex)

infra-runner: Rollback completed at 10:22:11Z. Memory metrics show 60% drop in allocation spikes within 2 minutes.

maria-eng: Status page updated: partial degradation for eu-west resolved for most requests, continuing to monitor.

samir-sre: Posting minimal repro steps to the incident thread and will attach heap dumps.

oncall-alex: Thanks all. Handoff: I'm stepping out at 10:45Z. Maria will be primary until 11:30Z. If PD escalates, page samir directly.

maria-eng: Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards set to 1m. I will escalate if allocation rate > 1/min sustained.

oncall-alex: Final note for postmortem: flag regression window, affected customers list, and add a CI mem-sanity test for streaming+function-call combos.

incident-bot: Incident 98321 status -> acknowledged by oncall-alex, annotated, and resolved -> monitoring.

maria-eng: Closing the PagerDuty after 30m of stable metrics unless any regressions. :white_check_mark:
